tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i mthus// 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa po// rdo rje 'jigs byed la btud de// de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// 'di yi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas 'di nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la ci bde bar kha lho phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas skad cig gis rang phyag gnyis par dmigs pa'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang na ma shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥs bla ma dang lha la phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ badz+ra la s+ye hūm̐ gis sgeg mo dkar mo/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trām̐ gis phreng ba ma ser mo/ oṃ badz+ra gī tī hrīḥs glu ma dmar mo/ oṃ badz+ra nirta'i āḥs gar ma ljang gu dang*/ yang oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐ gis bdug spos ma dkar mo/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ gis me tog ma ser mo/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hrīḥs mar me ma dmar mo/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥs dri ma ljang gu rnams rang gi snying ga nas spros la re re la'ang dpag tu med par gyur pas/ tshogs kyi zhing mchod nas/ dpal chen po'i thugs kar thim par bsam mo// de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa lan gsum dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// la sogs pas sdom pa gzung ba lan gsum byas nas/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/

btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes bdag gzhan thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyogs kun tu 'od zer 'phros pas las sra zhing brtan pa mi phyed cing rgya che ba/ rdo rje'i gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re phyi rol du bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me ri 'bar bas bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba 'bar bas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon sra zhing brtan pa'i gzhi la khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil du/ mi mgo skam po'i rwa ba zlum po sgo gcig dang ldan pa'i steng keng rus kyis phub pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi dang*/ rus pa'i phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gzhal med khang gi phyi rol du ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi dur khrod chen po brgyad phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ sprin dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ klu dang bcas shing grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang*/ ro langs dang*/ sha za dang*/ 'byung pos yongs su gang bas bskor ba'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi shes pa yi ge dhīḥnyi ma'i mdog can du dmigs pa las/

tshad med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jam dbyangs su gyur pa ni/ gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ bsgyings pa dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon pas ut+pa la la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na zas klubs shing 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ zhi ba dang sgeg pa dang 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan par blta'o// de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ bsams pa las phyogs bcur 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa spyan ras pa bdag la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i 'od kyi phung po chen por gyur/ de las yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas ā li dang kā li dang rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye ba'i sting po rnams/ rang rang gi sgra 'brug gi dbyangs ltar sgrogs bzhin pa dpag tu med pa bkug la thim pas/ hūm̐ gi yi ge mthing ga chen po zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ rdo rje dang gri gug dang thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa bkug la thim pas/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa shin tu gdengs pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa cig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams kyis gtugs pa'i snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i tshogs su byas nas slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las/

bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs// thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// khro bor gyur pa gshin rje gshed// zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum// g.yon brkyang rnam par bsgyings pas bzhugs// rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong*// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa// steng zhal dmar po rgya cher bzhad// de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal// gser gyi mdog can shin tu 'dzum// g.yas pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal// dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs// gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril zhing*// gsum pa ser po khro gnyer can// g.yon pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal// dang po dkar pos rmongs par byed// gnyis pa dud khas rengs par byed// gsum pa nag pos gsod par byed// khro zhal thams cad spyan gsum ldan// g.yas pa'i phyag rnams rim pa bzhin// gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing dang*// chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa// dgra s+t+wa mdung mda' lcags kyu dang*// dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo dang*// rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba dang*// ral gri rnge'u chung rim bzhin 'dzin// g.yon pa rnams kyis rim bzhin du// khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*// mgo phub rkang pa zhags pa gzhu// rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang*// ro ras skyes bu gsal shing phug /me thab thod tshal sdigs mdzub dang*// 'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras 'dzin// tha ma ya ni phyag gnyis kyis// glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon// zhabs g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du// mi dang ma he glang bong bu// rnga mo khyi lug ce spyang mnan// g.yon rnams rim bzhin bya rgod dang*// 'ug pa khwa dang bya rog dang*// ne tso khyung chen ri skegs bzhad// mnan zhing zhabs rnams thams cad kyis// tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang dang*// drag po gzhon nu gdong drug rnams// bsgyel nas kha sbub nyid du mnan// mi mgo skam po lnga lnga yis// khro zhal rnams kyi dbu la brgyan// mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang*// sbrul nag chun pos do shal byas// dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar// spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug

/rus rgyan drug gis sku la brgyan// thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang*// khrag zhag dmar po'i thig le dang*// zhag chen zo ris rnams kyis mtshan// liṅga dmar po gyen du langs// sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro// sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// rgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa yis// ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs// de ltar gsal bar dmigs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po bkod nas/ mig byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po/ rna ba phyag na rdo rje/ sna nam mkha'i snying po/ lce 'jig rten dbang phyug lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid kun tu bzang po/ zhes lhag par mos nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon pa la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnasas ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ thams cad kyis khro bo'i phyag mtshan dang*/

chos rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ khyad par du khro bo'i mthu stobs dang*/ phrin las la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje lcags kyu'i tshogs spros nas/ dbang gi lha de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du bkug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes brjod/ rdo rje zhags pa'i tshogs spros pas/ bdag la nye bar byon par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gi tshogs spros pas bdag la bstim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐/ zhes brjod/ de dag thams cad mnyes bzhin bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod do// de nas rang gi snying ga'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa' bsgom zhing*/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsam par bya'o// de nas 'di'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la gnas gsum du gtug cing*/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rī re re brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun du bdud rtsi mngon par 'dus byas la/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis ba rlabs pa lce la myangs pas lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang nas bde ba chen po skyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas rang gi thugs ka nas mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros pas bdag la mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// longs spyod yul du du mar snang*// shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no// 'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la// rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog

/a la la ho rol du gsol/ gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la// dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod// reg bya 'gag pa med pa la// mi g.yo bzhin du rol par mdzod// ho chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas lha mo de dag nyid kyasi bdag la bstod par bsam zhing*/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i// zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i// ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa// dud kha mun chen khyod la bstod// ces brjod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu sti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bya'o// de nas lha mo de dag rang gi thugs kar bsdus nas/ ji ltar bsgoms pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang la rang bzhin med pa/ dbang po'i gzhu 'dra ba la yid gtad de sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag par bya'o// bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ kye'i rdo rje las 'byung ba'i rim pa ltar bsgom pa nyid do// gang gi tshe sngags zlo bar 'dod pa de'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i nang gi khor yug tu nye snying dang*/ bar gyi khor yug tu snying po dang*/ phyi'i khor yug tu rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ g.yas phyogs su 'khor ba'i 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pas bdag dang bsgrub bya'i sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi/ bsod nams dang tshe dang 'byor pa rgyas/ 'gro ba thams cad dbang du bsdus/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad tshar bcad/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇā yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces bya ba'i rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i snying po'i sngags dang*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba nye ba'i snying po'i sngags rnams gang mos pa la ci nus pa bzlas par bya'o// bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas gtor ma'i rim pa'i tshul la gnyis las/ sha dang khrag la sogs pa mngon par 'dus byas pa'i gtor ma snga ma bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya ste/ nye snying gis bsangs shing*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ kam̐ gsum las thod pa'i sgyed pu chen po gsum dmigs pa'i steng du yam̐ las rlung dang*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥlas sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha bskyed la de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su ya/ shar nas rim pa bzhin du k+ṣe ma me da rnams bkod la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rlung g.yos me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge dang bcas pa rnams zhu nas/ spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du chags pa'i lte bar mi bskyod pa/ shar nas brtsams pa'i rim pa bzhin rnam snang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ snang ba mtha' yas/ don yod grub pa rnams so so'i yum dang bcas par gyur nas de rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas rigs lnga'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ de nyid kyi tshe bde ba chen po'i mes yab yum bcu 'od du zhu nas 'dres pa/ kha dog dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/

bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ ha ho hrīḥyang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dhīḥlas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa bskyed pa las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad khro bo'i rnam par gyur pa thim pa las byung ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed pa la/ dbang bskur zhing ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas pa'i 'khor du 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i 'khor thams cad kyis bskor bar bsams la/ de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing bstabs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas sngags gsum gyi mthar/ sarba bigh+nān sha trūn mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// la sogs pas kyang mchod nas/ snga ma bzhin du bstod la/ gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas kun// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// zhes pa la sogs pas 'phrin las gzhol zhing*/ gsol ba btab nas/ ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal bar bsams la/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs shing*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol lo// de nas gtor ma gnyis pa ni mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ma he'i steng du ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las/ las kyi gshin rje kha dog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas pas thod dbyug g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin zhing dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ liṅga dmar po gyen du langs shing gshin rje'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi gshin rje gshed 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/

oṃ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim mo// yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas gshin rje gshed rigs lnga spyan drangs/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan pa la/ oṃ kā la rū pa sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis dam la bzhag oṃ kā la rū pa sa ma ya grih+ne daṃ/ zhes kun la sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ dhū paṃ swā hā/ dī paṃ swā hā/ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ nai bi d+ye swā hā/ zhes pas mchod nas/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba bigh+nān sha trūṃ mā ra ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas/ hūm̐ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi// rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas// srog la rngam pa'i gshin rje ni// nag po ma he'i gdan stengs su// ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa ni// thod pas mtshan pa las byung ba// gting nas khros pa ma he'i gdong*// za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// khros pa'i spyan gsum dmar po 'khrug /skra ser sma ra gyen du brdzes// lag g.yon zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching*// lag g.yas dbyug pas rdul du rlog /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs// bran dang bcas pa'i dus la bab// sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi// gtor ma rgya mtsho mchod par bzhes// rgyal bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang*// snying rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// zung shig chings shig rnam par sdoms// khug cig drongs shig dbang du sdus// sod cig skrod cig rengs par gyis// phyi shig non cig rmugs par gyis// thul cig choms shig rnam par shig

/rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis// zhes phrin las bcol nas/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs par bzla bar bya'o// des kyang ji ltar bsgos pa'i don khas blangs par bsam mo// slar yang mchod nas bzod par gsol lo// de nas/ sems can thams cad bder gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces pa dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams// gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo ni// shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis// ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /ces smon lam gdab par bya'o// de nas oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ zhes pas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ oṃ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes pas gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i ye shes pa gshegs su gsol lo// dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus la/ gtor ma dor bar bya'o// gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// kha zas za ba'i tshe/ bza' btung dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag du dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par dmigs pa'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod nas snying gar bcom ldan 'das la/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyi sbyor bas bza' btung rnams bsreg rdzas su dmigs nas mchod pas lha'i tshogs thams cad mnyes shing tshim par bsam mo// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// nyal ba'i tshe phyi'i dngos po thams cad rang la bsdus shing*/ lus kyang snying ga'i hūm̐ la bsdus/ hūm̐ yang stong par gyur nas/ dmigs pa med pa'i ngang la nyal bar bya'o// nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro// nang par ldang ba'i tshe/ skad cig gis lha'i skur langs la/

de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i 'od kyis rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs te hūm̐ zhes brjod par bya'o// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ro// gang gi tshe spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa de'i tshe/ oṃ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi lha'i sku dang*/ āḥzhes brjod pas rang gis brjod pa dang*/ grags pa thams cad sngags dang*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sems kyi 'du 'phro thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs la/ lhas lha la mchod pa dang*/ lha la lhas longs spyod par bsam zhing dmigs pa med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas sdang zhen med par spyad par bya'o// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// 'di lta bu'i tshul gyis rtag tu gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni dgra dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis yongs su 'byor nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos kyi tshul// sems can khams bzhin bgrang yas las// theg pa chen po khyad par 'phags// de yi snying po rdo rje'i theg /gsang sngags rgya mtsho thams cad las// las kun bde blag sgrub byed cing*// gdug pa 'dul byed drag po yi// las la gshin rje gshed po bsngags// de yi tshul yang dpag yas las// ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor ni// khyad par 'phags zhes lung las 'byung*// gtan tshigs kyang ni 'di la snang*// de yi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim// 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can du// rnam par rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs pa'i// tshul lugs du ma byung mod kyang*// yang dag lung dang rjes mthun zhing*// man ngag du mas rnam par brgyan// nyung gsal bsdebs legs go bde ba'i// ngag gis rnam par bkrol ba 'di// rigs dang cho 'brang rnam par dag

/gzugs dang kun spyod kun nas mdzes// dad dang shes rab phun tshogs pa// ji big de mur gyis bskul nas// tshul khrims ldan zhing thos dang ldan// man ngag ldan zhing blo dang ldan// brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa// sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar// de las byung ba'i dge ba yis// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mthus// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor kun bcom nas// bde ba che la rol par shog /'di yi brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta/ bla ma rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ bla ma klog skya dbang phyug grags/ bla ma ldong ston shes rab dpal/ bla ma sngags 'chang ba 'phags pa'o// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs gsang ba las ches gsang ba/ gsang ba'i rnal 'byor grub pa zhes bya ba sa pho 'brug gi lo// ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bzhi'i nyin par bha wang gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// gshin rje gshed la gsar rnying gnyis yod pa las/ 'di gsar ma yin/ de la rtsa ba'i rgyud gsum yod pa las 'di gtso bor ston pa rtog pa bdun pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud las 'byung*/ de bod skad du bsgyur ba'i srol gsum tsam yod pa las/ khyad par 'phags pa rwa lugs zhes bgyi ba 'di lags/ bdag gis skyo lugs dang gnyis ka thos shing sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag gis brgyan nas bdag gis ma sbas par legs par bris pa 'di rdzogs so/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
